title: Ab mai paani na maangungi
body:
Ab mai pani na mangungi
Ro rahi hai tumhari sakina.....4
<<DIVIDER>>
Laut aao chacha alkama se pyase ashko se apni bujha lungi.....
Ab mai pani na mangungi.....2 Aur kuch roz pyaase rahe bhi toh kya, Pyaas se badhke gam aapka hai cahcha, Koi degana ab al atash ki sada....
Laut aao chacha alkama se...........
Pyaase bacho ko mai khud mana lungi.......
<<MINI>>
Ab mai pani na mangungi.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
Pani aae na aae mujhe gham nahi, Par ye furkat yatimi se kuch kam nahi, Yu samajh lo chacha tum nahi ham nahi , Laut aao chacha alkama se...........
Maina shikwa kabhi lab pe laungi.....
<<MINI>>
Ab mai pani na mangungi.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
Zalimone mujhe besahara kiya, Maine kaato pe chalna gawara kiya, Dil ke zakhmo ne nauha dubaara kiya, Laut aao chacha alkama se...........
Sab ghamo ko gale se laga lungi......
<<MINI>>
Ab mai pani na mangungi.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
Yu sitamgar mujhe ab satane lage, Paani mujhko dikhakar bahane lage, Zakhm dil ke tumhe fhir bulaane lage, Laut aao chacha alkama se...........
Zalimo se tamache bhi khalungi......
<<MINI>>
Ab mai pani na mangungi.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
Raah me mil bhi jaega pani agar, Daal dungi mai aabid ki zanjeer par, Haan ye nauha rahega labo par magar, Laut aao chacha alkama se...........
Pyaasa rehna mai khud no sikhaa lungi.....
<<MINI>>
Ab mai pani na mangungi.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
Chal basi qaid khane me jab ghamzada, Ghusl mayyat ko pani mayyasar na tha, Aae laashe sakina se us dam sada, Laut aao chacha alkama se...........
Mai bina ghusl ke hi sidharungi.....
<<MINI>>
Ab mai pani na mangungi.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek din shaam farhano mazhar gae, Ek mashqiza pani ka lekar gae, Ek sada sunke aysa laga mar gae, Laut aao chacha alkama se...........
Apna wada yahan bhi nibhalungi
<<MINI>>
Ab mai pani na mangungi.....2
Ro rahi hai tumhari sakina.....2
